_comment: Ratchet for bun run test:audit. Counts normally only go down: lower a number in the same commit that lowers the count. A number may go UP only when the DETECTOR got stricter and started seeing sites that were always there, never to admit new ones — raise it in the same commit as the detector change and record the reason below.
_sourceShape: 52. Raised from 18 when the source-shape detector stopped missing things, not when tests got worse: it had read only the test file itself, matched a path literal only where it ended at /src/ or /dist/, and required toContain/toMatch. That hid nine MCP tests reading packages/mcp/src through test/harness/mcp-source.ts, every read written as join(__dirname, '..', 'src', ...) or '../src/hub/hub-app.ts', and two stylesheet tests asserting a parsed value with toBe. What remains: the MCP suite's reads of the built plugin bundle and of its own sources; the server suite's reads of a published client release; seventeen app tests that read hub-app.ts, app.ts, hub-live-wiring.ts, doc-meeting-mount.ts and meeting-strip.ts as TEXT and assert on that text -- hub-app.ts and app.ts have exported bootHub and bootApp since PR 634, so the honest reason these stay is that nobody has converted them yet, not that there is nothing to import; and four stylesheet reads across three files, of which decide-option-hover-css.test.ts (a :hover treatment), hub-nav-widget-clearance-css.test.ts (a calc() of max() and env() that happy-dom discards whole) and shell-grid-placement.test.ts (grid auto-placement, which needs a layout engine) are all beyond happy-dom.
